title: A kétfejű sas és a Szent Korona (The Double-Headed Eagle & the Crown)
grammar: Dual State Structures, Commemorative Postpositions & Urban Innovation Verbs

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain how the dual system divided power between Vienna and Budapest.
I can use egyrészt … másrészt to compare the Hungarian government with the common army.
I can name the common affairs, the delegations and the common army in a citizenship interview.
I can read about the common ministries and the delegations and answer questions on them.
